E_input.prior_exposure: Legacy whole-file schema/clock/gap integrity audit included E; no E feature fitting, model selection, calibration or scoring. Do not claim feature/schema blindness.
E_input.tail: retain all incomplete final windows and events

candidate_budget.basis: BUDGET-BASIS.json; original D timings are not a runtime guarantee for unread E
candidate_budget.remaining_budget_rule: admit each stage only within min(stage grant, actual whole remaining minus internal reserve); reserve is not extra time or a completion guarantee; final archive verification and exit must remain within whole cap

chronology: Prospective only with respect to E. The current three-seed development study, C1 and C2 decisions already exist; this does not preregister them retrospectively.

include: all C1/C2 phases and discarded partial work
costs.nested_costs: record named scopes; do not add an inner fit or calibration timer again to its containing full process cost
costs.parallel_wall: retain calendar interval and individual attempt wall; do not sum concurrent walls and call it end-to-end elapsed time

current_development_study.recorded_selection_rule: strict maximum D macro-F1 checkpoint per fit; LR selection by mean D across all three seeds with every outcome retained; E sealed

default_action: Do not consume E. Parent separately decides after all six C2 chains terminate and independent audit/cost review.

artifacts: separate labels and exact source-row/episode/position order
all batch/process/whole logs and terminal rusage
evaluation.cache: cold per model, inside its charged process time
evaluation.checkpoint_metadata_deserialization: allowed for safe original-file loading; unused optimizer/RNG metadata discarded in memory; no checkpoint writes
evaluation.failure: retain fixed roster and all known costs; no retries, seed/checkpoint substitution or partial comparative conclusion; global source failure aborts remaining opportunities
evaluation.source: exact existing v8 forward/runtime/config and frozen shared tensors; no updated training implementation substituted

formal_protocol.after_E_disclosure: Later five-seed refits cannot call the same E previously unseen; disclose prior use or acquire new independent confirmation data.
formal_protocol.candidate_name: one independent-subject check of existing three-seed v3 systems

inherited_rules: all 256-event nonoverlapping windows with reset and original artificial-boundary first gap
all attempts, failed and discarded work charged
one held-out subject limits population inference

independent review of final program and precise authorization

reporting.ECE_bin_definition: [k/15,(k+1)/15) for k<14; final bin includes confidence=1

bootstrap.draw: five independent randrange(5) indices per replicate, shared by all models and seeds
bootstrap.quantile: sort 5000 values; linear interpolation at q*(5000-1)
bootstrap.statistic: mean over three seed-paired macro-F1 differences
bootstrap.unit: whole E sequence; pool each selected sequence confusion matrix with multiplicity

reporting.incomplete_21_roster: HOLD; preserve artifacts/failed costs but withhold complete comparative conclusion
reporting.inferential_claim: No confirmatory population superiority or causal mechanism claim; three-seed two-sided sign-flip space has only 8 possibilities (minimum attainable p=.25).
reporting.primary_paired_comparator: HCSN minus GRU at matched seed; report all three raw differences and their mean/sample SD
reporting.primary_quality: 11-class macro-F1, zero_division=0 for any absent class
reporting.tables: overall plus E01..E05; each seed, three-seed arithmetic mean and sample SD; no best-seed expected-quality claim

scientific_status: HOLD; any eventual E result would be a supplementary independent-subject check of existing systems, not completion of the formal recipe or numerical/causal/energy gates

selection.exact_LR_tie: 0.001 (lower LR); matches frozen current resource/C2 auditor helpers, not the original formal capacity/compute tie rule
selection.missing_seed: HOLD; do not drop it or replace it with another seed/LR
selection.per_arm: maximum arithmetic mean of the same three seeds at a common LR
selection.within_fit: first strict maximum over all authentic complete-epoch D observations in the chosen phase chain

temperature.endpoints: If derivative at lower endpoint >=0 choose lower; otherwise if derivative at upper endpoint <=0 choose upper; record boundary optimum.
temperature.failure_policy: HOLD before E; no bounds expansion, restarts or post-E recalibration
temperature.flat_exception: If every event has exactly equal logits across all 11 classes, beta=1.
temperature.interior_solver: Bisection on derivative sign; at most 100 iterations; stop when bracket width <=1e-12*max(1,abs(midpoint)) or no representable strict interior point; choose final bracket midpoint.
temperature.objective: unweighted mean multiclass D NLL; stable logsumexp with per-event max-logit centering
temperature.receipt: raw input hashes, finite checks, endpoint gradients, final bracket/beta/NLL and exact argmax agreement
temperature.scope: each already-selected model; independently verified D logits only; freeze 21 temperature results before any E read
